scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:assets
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test:vitest
scripts.test:scripts: node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/capture-ui.test.mjs scripts/wiki-sprites.test.mjs scripts/game-assets.test.mjs scripts/native-artwork.test.mjs scripts/mod-artwork.test.mjs scripts/bundle-mod.test.mjs scripts/bundle-mod-library.test.mjs scripts/game-version.test.mjs scripts/update-game-data.test.mjs scripts/calculations.test.mjs scripts/update-entity-reference.test.mjs scripts/world-acquisition.test.mjs scripts/world-map.test.mjs scripts/check-e2e-contracts.test.mjs scripts/integration-verification.test.mjs scripts/verify-vitest.test.mjs scripts/offline-plugin.test.mjs scripts/source-audit-evidence.test.mjs scripts/account-watch.test.mjs scripts/opaque-worker-module.test.mjs scripts/accounts-deployment.test.mjs scripts/account-network-fixture.test.mjs
scripts.test:vitest: npm run build:account-tests && npm run test:vitest:prepared
scripts.test:persistence: npm run build:account-tests && vitest run --project persistence --project persistence-service
scripts.check: npm run check:deterministic && npm run build:assets
scripts.check:deterministic: npm run check:deterministic:base && npm run test:vitest
scripts.check:deterministic:base: npm run check:e2e-contracts && npm run typecheck && npm run test:scripts && npm run class-trees:check && npm run calculations:check && npm run game-identities:check && npm run game-assets:check && npm run game-data:check && npm run entity-reference:check && npm run native-reference-links:check && npm run world-acquisition:check && npm run world-map:check && npm run sprites:check && npm run mods:artwork:check && npm run mods:library:check && npm run certainty:check && npm run sources:check && npm run check:privacy
scripts.deploy:preview:dry-run: npm run build:preview && npm run check:assets && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:preview && npm run check:assets && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.jsonc
scripts.calculations:check: node scripts/update-native-stats.mjs --check && node scripts/update-combat-calculations.mjs --check && node scripts/render-calculation-reference.mjs --check
scripts.test:worker: npm run build:account-tests && vitest run --project worker
scripts.test:e2e:accounts:acceptance: npm run build:account-tests && vite build --config vite.accounts.config.ts && npm run test:e2e:accounts:prepared
scripts.prepare:verification: npm run build:account-tests && npm run build:assets && vite build --config vite.accounts.config.ts
